in_hebrew.name: Andromeda
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו In Greek mythology, Andromeda was a princess chained to a rock as a sacrifice to a sea monster. Saved by Perseus.
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Andromeda הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Andromeda is a mythological princess in Greek mythology, who was chained to a rock as a sacrifice to a sea monster. She was saved by Perseus, who freed her and married her. The name is derived from the Greek words 'ander' (man) and 'mede' (in the middle), suggesting a 'man in the middle' or 'chained one'. This name carries the symbolic message of sacrifice and redemption.

in_greek.name: Ἀνδρομέδα
in_greek.long_meaning: From 'anēr', man, and 'dromē', to run. A chained woman in Greek mythology.
